$comment: One hook, two schemas. VS Code reads PascalCase event names with a `command` property and a `timeout`; Copilot cloud agent and CLI read camelCase event names with `bash`/`powershell` and `timeoutSec`. Each host ignores the block it does not recognize, so the hook fires exactly once in either. Sources: https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/agent-customization/hooks and https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/concepts/agents/hooks
